clue.text: During audition, amateur is most uninteresting

indicators.note: something happening during another event sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: an audition is a test of a performer
AM is the standard abbreviation for amateur

explanation.surface: A talent-show judge finds the amateur act the dullest of the lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'During audition' sounds like a cue to listen for a sound-alike, but 'audition' is simply a trial and 'During' puts one piece inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative synonym: the dullest, most docile and least exciting is the most insipid.

clue.text: Tone down a painter's medium

parts.note: to temper something is to moderate or soften it

explanation.surface: A painter is told to soften the colours in their paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Egg-yolk based paint used by early Italian artists is a binding medium for pigment.

clue.text: Distance Tory leader goes into pond

indicators.note: the leader goes into, inside, the pond

parts.note: a mere is a small lake or pond

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter of Tory

explanation.surface: A Conservative party chief takes a dip in a pond.
explanation.definitionFit: The base unit of length in the metric system is a measure of distance.

clue.text: Author of People In Israel

indicators.note: the people go in the word for Israel

parts.note: Sion, or Zion, is a poetic name for Israel
men are people

explanation.surface: Reads like the title of a book by a writer: People in Israel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'People In Israel' poses as a book title; Sion (Zion) is an old poetic name for Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: Georges Simenon was the Belgian novelist who created Inspector Maigret.

clue.text: Husband put in place, wandering in religious venue

indicators.note: the husband is put in, placed inside the other letters
the letters of place wander out of their usual order

explanation.surface: A husband is settled somewhere, his mind drifting during a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wandering' makes CAPEL from PLACE, and 'put in' sets H inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A small place of Christian worship, often nonconformist, is a common kind of religious building.

clue.text: Hospital appears on direction indicator in London

indicators.note: in a down clue the hospital letter sits on top of the indicator

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
an arrow shows a direction

explanation.surface: A road sign in London points the way to hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a place in London: HARROW is a London borough, home of a famous school.
explanation.definitionFit: A district and borough of north-west London, so a place situated there.

clue.text: Exercise about to strengthen soldiers' disposition

indicators.note: the exercise goes about, around, the other pieces

parts.note: PT is physical training, exercise
to lace a drink is to fortify it with spirits
men are soldiers, the ranks

explanation.surface: Drill is used to toughen up how the troops are deployed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the arrangement or positioning of things, as in troop dispositions.

clue.text: A long time in the business of a beastly king

indicators.note: the long time goes in the word for business

parts.note: a line is a line of business or trade
an eon is an immensely long period

explanation.surface: A long reign in the trade of a cruel monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'beastly king' is the lion, king of beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective meaning like or of a lion, the proverbial king of the beasts.

clue.text: Student's oddly guarded nature

indicators.note: oddly means in a strange way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A student is strangely secretive by temperament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' suggests alternate letters, but here it means the letters of GUARDED NATURE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A university student who has not yet taken a first degree.

clue.text: Coarseness makes stomachs turn

indicators.note: to turn round means the word for stomachs is read backwards

parts.note: tums is informal for stomachs or bellies

explanation.surface: Crude talk is enough to make one feel queasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Obscene or vulgar material is called filth, a synonym for crude coarseness.

clue.text: Island lacking a clergyman

parts.note: Minorca is a Balearic island in the Mediterranean
non is a prefix meaning not, lacking

explanation.surface: A Mediterranean island has no vicar of its own.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral cleric who is not a member of the chapter holds a lesser title in the church hierarchy.

clue.text: Clergyman keeps setter humble

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: a dean is a senior clergyman heading a cathedral chapter
the crossword setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A churchman takes the puzzle compiler down a peg.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to humble someone is to lower or degrade their dignity.

clue.text: Inscrutable Tories assembled in the City

indicators.note: the shuffled letters sit inside the City's postcode

parts.note: EC is the postcode area for the City of London

indicators.note: the letters of Tories are assembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Conservatives gathering in London's financial district are hard to read.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembled' makes SOTERI from TORIES; it goes 'in' EC, the City of London's postal district.
explanation.definitionFit: Something understood only by a small initiated group is obscure and hard to fathom.

clue.text: Priest's crime taking time in a clerical residence

indicators.note: the priest and crime take the time on after them

parts.note: P is an abbreviation for priest
arson is the crime of deliberately setting fire to property
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A priest's offence lingers on in a vicarage.
explanation.walkthrough: P is a dictionary abbreviation for priest.
explanation.definitionFit: The house provided for a parish priest is a vicarage or rectory.

clue.text: Endorsement for Sicilian leaders' good temperament

indicators.note: the leaders are the opening letters of Sicilian

parts.note: a person's nature is their temperament

explanation.surface: A recommendation praising the calm disposition of Mafia bosses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' is plural, so the first two letters of Sicilian, SI.
explanation.definitionFit: Signing a document, such as the back of a cheque, is an endorsement of it.

clue.text: Goddess makes man exist

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
to be is to exist

explanation.surface: A goddess creates man and brings him into being.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she is the deity of youth and cupbearer to the Olympians.

clue.text: Mammoth's initially grey in colour

indicators.note: the initial letter goes in the word for colour

parts.note: a hue is a colour or shade

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of grey

explanation.surface: A woolly mammoth's coat starts out grey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mammoth' reads as the animal, but it is the adjective meaning enormous.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective synonym: something gigantic or enormous is vast in size.

clue.text: Husband's manner stung? That's distressing?

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for husband
an air is a manner or bearing
cut, as in cut to the quick, means hurt or stung

explanation.surface: A wife asks whether her husband's hurt manner signals real upset.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a pun: 'distressing' is read as de-tressing, removing tresses (locks of hair).
explanation.definitionFit: A trim removes tresses, so it literally de-tresses the head.

clue.text: Argue over remedy for an aching tooth

definitions.meaning: to argue a matter through fully and frankly, settling a dispute
literally, to get the bad tooth extracted

explanation.surface: Two ways to settle a painful problem: a row, or the dentist's pliers.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to thrash out a quarrel; literally it is to get something removed.

clue.text: Player paused awkwardly and slowed down

parts.note: E, East, is one of the four players at bridge

indicators.note: awkwardly means clumsily arranged, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A performer hesitated clumsily and lost pace.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the four players are North, South, East and West, so a 'player' can be E.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: to reduce speed or effort, to relax the pace.

clue.text: Peacekeepers heard but not yet proven

parts.note: the UN, United Nations, sends peacekeeping forces
a case heard in court has been tried

explanation.surface: Blue-helmeted troops have been listened to, but their worth is untested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heard' looks like a sound signal, but it means judged in court.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something untested has not been put to the proof.

clue.text: Theologian to have main meal about six

indicators.note: the meal word goes about, around, the number

parts.note: to dine is to eat dinner
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A cleric eats his dinner around six o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Noun sense: a cleric or scholar of theology is called a divine.

clue.text: Is it a rum cocktail that's sweet?

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so these letters are mixed together

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a rum-based mixed drink is sugary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' is the anagram signal on IS IT A RUM.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian coffee-and-mascarpone dessert is a pudding, which British usage calls a sweet.

clue.text: Moans about time in places of interest

indicators.note: the sounds of moaning go about, around, the time

parts.note: sighs are moans or groans

explanation.surface: Tourists grumble the whole time they are dragged round the attractions.
explanation.definitionFit: The notable attractions a tourist goes to see are called the sights.

clue.text: German party is subdued

parts.note: a rave is a large dance party

explanation.surface: A German partygoer is unusually quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: serious and solemn in manner, sober and quiet.

clue.text: Virtuoso keeps old-fashioned duke on friendly terms

indicators.note: the virtuoso keeps, holds inside, the old-fashioned word

parts.note: an ace is an expert or virtuoso
quaint means charmingly old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A star performer keeps company with an antiquated aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: People who know one another socially are familiar, on friendly terms.

clue.text: Dehydrated in the Kalahari Desert

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words Kalahari Desert, spanning both

explanation.surface: Parched, as anyone would be in the Kalahari Desert.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: land with no moisture at all is dry and parched.

clue.text: Most of the elite found in ancient Egypt

indicators.note: most of means the word for elite loses its final letter

parts.note: the elite are the best, the pick of the bunch

explanation.surface: Egyptian high society was largely the cream of the crop.
explanation.walkthrough: THE BEST loses its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The great city on the Nile was the capital of Egypt under the New Kingdom, a place located there.

clue.text: Study the odds before broadcast

indicators.note: the odds come before the word for study

parts.note: SP, starting price, is the betting odds when a race starts
to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: A punter studies the betting before a race is aired.
explanation.walkthrough: SP is the starting price, the odds at the off in British horse racing.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb synonym: to broadcast news or seed is to scatter it widely.
